column1: # Alt written 12 Aug 2026 from contact sheets 02, 03, 07, 08 and 11, plus
# direct renders of indices 12 and 63 where the cell was too small to read.
# Shikhar is "Ongoing · bookings open", so the scaffolding and safety
# netting in the exteriors are current fact, not a §6.7 problem — that
# guardrail protects the three DELIVERED projects only.
# The eight aerials look three ways: over the railway line to the wooded
# hill, over the neighbourhood streets, and across to the airport.
# None of them is "aerial view over the rooftop and surroundings".
